fields.name: Tag Version
fields.description: RFID tag data format version, with 3 implied decimal points. Eg `1000` → version `1.000`.

fields.name: Base Material Name
fields.description: Material name in plain text, excluding any modifiers.

fields.name: Material Modifiers
fields.description: Material subcategory or modifier in plain text. Long modifiers may need to be abbreviated.

fields.name: Filament Manufacturer
fields.description: Name of filament manufacturer. Long names should be abbreviated or truncated.

fields.name: Color Name
fields.description: Color in plain text.

fields.name: Color 1 Hex
fields.description: Primary filament color stored as 4 separate 1-byte integers for red, green, blue and alpha, in the sRGB color space.

fields.name: Color 2 Hex
fields.description: Second filament color, if the filament is multi-color. Set to transparent black if the filament is single color.

fields.name: Color 3 Hex
fields.description: Third filament color, if the filament is multi-color. Set to transparent black if the filament is dual color.

fields.name: Color 4 Hex
fields.description: Fourth filament color, if the filament is multi-color. Set to transparent black if the filament is tri color.

fields.name: Serial Number / Batch ID
fields.description: Manufacturer's identifier for a spool batch or serial number.

fields.name: SKU
fields.description: Product SKU for the material and color.

fields.name: Barcode
fields.description: The barcode number for the spool. This can be UPC12, UPC13, GS1/GTIN. (Recommended: UPC13)

fields.name: Manufacture Date
fields.description: Stored as 2 bytes for year, then 1 byte for month and 1 byte for day.

fields.name: Manufacture Time
fields.description: Stored as 1 byte each for hour, minute, and second in 24-hour UTC.

fields.name: Filament Diameter
fields.description: Filament (target) diameter in µm (micrometers). Eg `1750` → `1.750mm`.

fields.name: Measured Tolerance
fields.description: Measured tolerance in µm (micrometers).

fields.name: Minimum Nozzle Diameter
fields.description: Minimum nozzle diameter in mm (millimeters) with an implied decimal point. Eg `2` → `0.2mm`

fields.name: Target Print Temperature
fields.description: Recommended print temperature in degrees Celsius, divided by 5. For example, `42` = `210°C`.

fields.name: Minimum Print Temperature
fields.description: Minimum nozzle temperature, divided by 5. For example, `38` = `190ºC`.

fields.name: Maximum Print Temperature
fields.description: Maximum nozzle temperature, divided by 5.

fields.name: Target Bed Temperature
fields.description: Recommended bed temperature in degrees Celsius, divided by 5. For example, `12` = `60°C`.

fields.name: Minimum Bed Temperature
fields.description: Minimum bed temperature, divided by 5. For example, `8` = `40ºC`.

fields.name: Maximum Bed Temperature
fields.description: Maximum bed temperature, divided by 5.

fields.name: Target Chamber Temperature
fields.description: Recommended chamber temperature in degrees Celsius, divided by 5. For example, `12` = `60°C`.

fields.name: Target Volumetric Speed
fields.description: Default recommended speed.

fields.name: Minimum Volumetric Speed
fields.description: Mininum speed recommendation.

fields.name: Maximum Volumetric Speed
fields.description: Maximum safe speed.

fields.name: Maximum Dry Temperature
fields.description: Maximum safe drying temperature, divided by 5.

fields.name: Dry Time
fields.description: Recommended drying time.

fields.name: Transmission Distance (TD)
fields.description: Opaque thickness in tens of millimeters Eg. `118` → `11.8`.

fields.name: Density
fields.description: Filament density in µg (micrograms) per cubic centimeter. Eg `1240` → `1.240g/cm³`. (Recommendations: 1.24 for PLA, 1.07 for ABS, 1.27 for PETG)

fields.name: Target Weight
fields.description: Filament weight in grams, excluding spool weight. This is the TARGET weight (e.g., 1kg). Actual measured weight is stored in a different field.

fields.name: Empty Spool Weight
fields.description: Weight of empty spool in grams.

fields.name: Measured Filament Length
fields.description: Length in meters.

fields.name: Measured Filament Weight
fields.description: Weight of filament only. This should be the actual measurement taken

fields.name: Spool Core Diameter
fields.description: Core diameter in mm (millimeters).

fields.name: MFI Temp
fields.description: MFI test temperature, divided by 5. For example, `42` = `210ºC`.

fields.name: MFI Load
fields.description: MFI test load grams, divided by 10. For example, `216` = `2.16kg`.

fields.name: MFI Value
fields.description: MFI value, divided by 10.

fields.name: Online Data URL
fields.description: URL to access online JSON additional parameters. Formatted without `https` to save space.
